newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber edges down in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber edges down in slow trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices edged down in slow late trading on Tuesday following foreign buying in Palembang, dealers said.
Dealers said January SIR20 offer prices edged down 0.25 cents/lb to 54.25-55.25 cents/lb fob Medan, 54.50-55.00 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang, 53.75-54.25 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
One Palembang dealer said Singapore-based dealers bought January SIR20 at 53.75-54.00 after the lunch break, but the offtakes were not known.
Demand for December/January SIR20 were soft due to year-end factors and there were only few enquiries for February, dealers said.
Dealers said prompt delivery latex was on offer at 2,150 rupiah/kg against the previous 2,200 rupiah due to weak demand.
